download.title: Downloading files
blocked.title: Needs a manual download
blocked.description: The authors of these files forbade third-party launchers to distribute them - CurseForge gives no direct links. Download them from the pages below: the launcher watches the downloads folder itself, matches files by checksum and marks them here. Renaming what you downloaded is not needed, but does no harm.
blocked.missing_hint: Missing files get marked on their own as soon as they finish downloading. If the browser puts them somewhere else - point to that folder. You can continue without them: the pack will be incomplete and the list will stay on the «Modpack» tab.
blocked.all_found_hint: Everything is here. The launcher will fetch the rest of the pack files itself - it won't stop again.
